title: Phase 0: Astro scaffold + design system foundation
description: Init Astro 5 project, integrations (mdx/rss/sitemap), self-hosted fonts (Literata + Hanken Grotesk), tokens.css (OKLCH warm-archival + dark viewing-room), typography.css, BaseLayout, ThemeScript/ThemeToggle, Header/Footer, BaseHead/SEO. Stand up render.yaml. Goal: live placeholder deploy validating the pipeline.

title: Phase 4: Launch sjarmak.ai
description: Render custom domain + DNS for sjarmak.ai, TLS, canonical apex, www->apex, Cloudflare Web Analytics, Lighthouse + a11y audit.

title: Phase 5: Knowledge-graph projects explorer
description: /projects/explorer. buildGraph.ts (edges from references), GraphFallback.astro (accessible, ships first), Cytoscape.js + fcose island (dynamic import), interactions, light/dark theming. Additive, can slip past launch.

title: Phase 2: Core pages (launchable site)
description: home/about, /cv, /work, /projects (+detail), /research, /writing (+on-site posts), /talks (webinar facade), /contact, /404, RSS, sitemap, robots, JSON-LD, canonical->.ai.

title: Phase 1: Content collections + WordPress migration
description: Author src/content.config.ts (all zod schemas: cv, publications, press, projects, topics, outputs, writing, posts, talks, astrophoto, art). Migrate+curate content from WordPress, updated to current Sourcegraph/SciX identity. Build legacy-URL redirect map.

title: Phase 3: Galleries (astrophotography + art)
description: Cloudinary setup for full-res originals, Astro <Image> display masters, PhotoSwipe lightbox. /astrophotography grid + /art (music/book embeds).

title: Phase 6: sjarmak.com 301 redirect (deferred)
description: Blocked on WordPress.com DNS access. Whole-domain 301 .com->.ai + legacy URL map, verify in Search Console.
